howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Get help from a real person in four simple steps.

steps.title: Open Support Chat
steps.description: Go to the Support page in your dashboard. You'll see a simple chat interface where you can type your message directly — no ticket forms or categories to choose from.

steps.title: Describe Your Question
steps.description: Type your message. Ask about setup, features, menu optimization, billing, or anything else. There are no stupid questions — we're happy to help with everything.

steps.title: Get a Personal Response
steps.description: A real person (not a chatbot) reads your message and responds within hours. We understand restaurant workflows and give practical, actionable answers.

steps.title: Ongoing Help
steps.description: Request feature suggestions, get menu optimization tips, or ask for setup assistance anytime. Your conversation history is saved, so we always have context from previous questions.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our support.

items.question: Is support available on the free plan?
items.answer: Yes. Personal support is available for every plan, including free. We believe every restaurant deserves real help, regardless of their subscription.

items.question: How fast do you respond?
items.answer: Typically within a few hours during business days. We read every message personally and aim to resolve your question in one reply.

items.question: Can you help me set up my menu?
items.answer: Absolutely. If you need help adding dishes, organizing categories, setting up translations, or configuring reservations — just ask. We're happy to walk you through it.

items.question: Can I suggest new features?
items.answer: Yes, and we love it! Many of our features started as user suggestions. Message us with your idea and we'll consider it for future updates.

items.question: Is support automated or human?
items.answer: 100% human. Every message is read and answered by a real person who understands the platform and restaurant industry. No chatbots, no canned responses.

items.question: Can I contact support by email?
items.answer: Yes. You can message us through the dashboard chat or send an email to support@iq-rest.com. Both channels reach the same team and get the same fast response.

items.question: What languages does support work in?
items.answer: We primarily respond in English, but we can assist in several other languages. If you write in your language, we'll do our best to respond in the same language.
